values.note: Daily rate: $27 for 30-amp, $29 for 50-amp; every site pull-through with full hookups, cable and Wi-Fi. Monthly $400 ($450 with cable), 3-month minimum. No refunds.

note: Convenient overnight/transient park just off I-75 in Lake City. Sites mostly grass and fairly level; cable, bathhouse, propane; after-hours pull-up sites for late arrivals. AGE-RESTRICTED: 55+ ('we are a 55 and over park'; caseyjonesrvpark.com, 2026-10-21). --Claude
